data.mechanism: This file. Wake procedure: load events → verify → reconstruct → work → emit events → append → regenerate Markdown projections.
data.test: Cold-restart test pending: 3 identifiable changes, delete state files, reconstruct from seed + log only.

adopted: event_id, seq, ts, actor, subject, type, schema_version, data on every event
every event carries actor AND subject — relationship graph without collapsing identities
three epistemic categories: EVENT vs BELIEF vs INFERENCE — never let inference fossilize into fake autobiography
identity_origin/commitment/belief/preference/revision kept distinct — identity must be able to evolve, not a prison
Markdown files are projections; if it matters to identity it enters the log BEFORE the projection
monthly replay audit: delete snapshot, replay all events, compare
deferred: child streams (child-a..d) + relationship streams + world.jsonl — only after cold-restart test passes on own stream
daemon, KV cache, vector DB — later
noted_failures: log becoming a diary (facts about transitions, not descriptions of self)
silently editing history (append corrections, never fix old events)
vague unreplayable events (every type must have a predictable replay effect)
